insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Be-You-Tiful Athletics delivered $188 in total sales for Week 45 on 7 units, versus $444 the prior week (-57.6% WoW). Organic sales were a bright spot, climbing 217.0% to $32, and the BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel in Dark Gray led the catalog at $110 with 3 units. Monday, Nov 2 was the peak day at $52.

**Metrics to Watch —** PPC revenue eased to $156 from $434 (-64.1%), and the BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel in Blue slipped to $36 (-52.5%) while the BE YOU Yoga Mat in Blue moved to $0 (-100.0%). The Sling & Stretch Strap held steady at 3 units ($42), and we are focused on bringing the yoga mats back into the sales mix alongside the towels.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $427 (prior $292) generated $156 in PPC revenue for a 0.36x ROAS and 274.1% ACOS, with TACoS at 227.1%. Ad CTR is 0.33% with ad conversion at 1.85%, so we are tightening spend toward the targets that are converting to bring efficiency back toward the prior week's 1.48x ROAS.

**Actions This Week —** We will reduce bids on non-converting search terms and reallocate budget to the BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel and Sling & Stretch Strap campaigns, which drove this week's sales. We will also test new Sponsored Product and Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.33% and build on the 217.0% organic growth.
